These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment.

new_jobs.title: SEO & AEO Manager
new_jobs.description: Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid model, and candidates in this role can be based remotely. You may be expected to travel to meet in person during your team’s scheduled collaboration weeks. Managers will determine in-person time according to business needs. This hybrid approach helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture, with the flexibility of working from home, whenever you need focus time. About Superhuman Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’ collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here . The Opportunity We are looking for an SEO Manager to help grow traffic and visibility through traditional search and emerging AI-driven discovery experiences across Superhuman’s domain portfolio: Grammarly.com , Superhuman.com , GPTZero.me , and Fathom.ai . Reporting to the Group Manager of SEO & AEO, you’ll work cross-functionally to build and execute a Search Everywhere Optimization strategy with a focus on one or more domains within our portfolio. You’ll partner closely with Growth Content, Product Marketing, Web, Engineering, Analytics, and other teams to identify opportunities, turn them into clear recommendations, and see the work through to launch and measurement. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone with a strong SEO foundation and curiosity about how search is changing. You should be comfortable moving from research and analysis to execution: improving pages and templates, diagnosing technical issues, shaping content opportunities, supporting launches, and using performance data to decide what to do next. You will help us improve visibility across Google and other search engines while building our understanding of how people discover, evaluate, and cite our products in AI Overviews, answer engines, and AI assistants. In This Role, You Will: Own SEO and AEO projects from identifying the opportunity through launch and measuring results. Research what people are searching for, what competitors are doing, and where we have the strongest opportunities to grow across content, products, and tools. Make recommendations for new and existing pages, from search intent and content structure to metadata, internal linking, and structured data. Work with Growth Content and Product Marketing to turn search insights into content briefs, editorial plans, new products and tools, and launch recommendations. Partner with Web and Engineering on technical SEO work, including crawlability, indexing, site structure, rendering, structured data, page speed, and internal linking. Track organic performance, understand what is driving changes in traffic, rankings, CTR, conversions, and new users, and recommend what to do next. Investigate SEO issues using tools like Google Search Console, analytics platforms, site crawls, release history, and competitive research. Help us learn how our content shows up in AI-driven search, including Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other emerging platforms. Help build a practical way to measure visibility in AI search, including citations, brand mentions, sentiment, and business impact. Support offsite SEO work, including opportunities to earn relevant links, brand mentions, and third-party citations. Translate SEO insights into clear reporting and actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical partners. Present findings to stakeholders and leadership, and use evidence to influence product roadmaps and priorities. Keep up with changes in search and AI, and help the team decide which ones are worth acting on. What You’ll Own: You will drive SEO and AEO initiatives, taking responsibility for their execution and results. This includes setting plans for your work, coordinating with partners, escalating risks or dependencies early, and using data to assess impact and improve the next iteration. You will contribute to team KPIs for organic visibility, qualified traffic, new active users, conversions, and AI search presence. Qualifications Has 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with a record of driving measurable organic growth. Has a well-rounded SEO foundation across on-page optimization, content strategy, technical SEO, and offsite authority. Can independently investigate an opportunity or problem, form a clear hypothesis, recommend a path forward, and execute with partners. Uses data to make decisions and can connect SEO performance to meaningful business outcomes, not rankings alone. Is comfortable with Google Search Console, Google Analytics or similar analytics tools, and leading SEO platforms such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, or seoClarity. Understands core technical SEO concepts, including crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, site architecture, internal linking, structured data, and page performance. Has experience working closely with content, product marketing, web, engineering, design, analytics, or external partners. Communicates clearly and can explain SEO findings and recommendations to audiences with different levels of technical knowledge. Is organized and able to prioritize multiple workstreams with cross-functional dependencies across short- and medium-term timelines. Is curious about AI-driven search and eager to develop practical AEO expertise. Embodies Superhuman’s values and brings a high level of ownership, sound judgment, and follow-through. Nice to Have: Experience with both B2C and B2B or product-led growth SEO. Experience working on a large, high-traffic website or a multi-domain portfolio. Experience with international SEO, including hreflang, localized content, and multi-market performance analysis. Experience supporting site migrations, redesigns, or major changes to site architecture. Experience with SEO experimentation, conversion-rate optimization, or using SEO insights to improve product and landing-page experiences. Experience building or improving scalable content systems, template-based pages, programmatic SEO, or internal linking frameworks. Familiarity with AI-search and AEO tracking tools, such as Profound, and with platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, or other technical skills that make collaboration with Web and Engineering teams easier. Experience with digital PR, link acquisition, or brand-mention and citation-building programs. Compensation And Benefits Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more: Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits) Disability and life insurance options 401(k) and RRSP matching Paid parental leave 20 days of paid time off per year, 12 days of paid holidays per year, two floating holidays per year, and flexible sick time Generous stipends (including those for caregiving, pet care, wellness, your home office, and more) Annual professional development budget and opportunities Superhuman takes a market-based approach to compensation, so base pay may vary by location. Our US locations are categorized into two compensation zones based on proximity to our hub locations. For more information about our compensation zones and locations where we currently support employment, please refer to this page . If a location of interest is not listed, please speak with a recruiter for additional information. Base pay may vary considerably depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The expected salary ranges for this position are outlined below by compensation zone and may be modified in the future. We encourage you to apply At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political belief, or any other characteristic protected by law. Superhuman is an equal opportunity employer and a participant in the US federal E-Verify program (US). We also abide by the Employment Equity Act (Canada).

new_jobs.title: Head of Marketing
new_jobs.description: $127B industry. Should be $300B. We're building the platform to get it there. The catch: the market thinks we're an upgrade. We're a new category. Your job as Head of Marketing is to close that gap, make the transformation obvious, and turn that clarity into growth. Small team, weekly ships, AI-first. If you want to help craft the story that will change an industry, let's talk. ABOUT TERN Tern is a venture-backed software company on a mission to reshape the $127B travel agency industry by giving power back to the entrepreneurs who built it. Nearly 98% of travel agencies are small businesses. These businesses have been chronically underserved by technology. We're here to change that. Our platform helps travel advisors run more efficient, professional, and profitable operations, giving them the modern infrastructure they need to lead the next chapter of travel. But the impact goes beyond business. Travel advisors help clients move more intentionally through the world. When a traveler works with an advisor, they're more likely to avoid overtouristed hotspots and more likely to spend their dollars in places where they can do real good. That's the kind of travel we want more of. At Tern, we believe in small business. We believe in the power of travel. And we're building the future of both. HEAD OF MARKETING As a Head of Marketing, you'll work with our existing brand and demand gen team, partnering directly with Sales as a GTM counterpart. Tern is building a new category in travel, and the market hasn't caught up yet. Advisors on Tern make more money. They spend less time on admin. We're building the first modern back-office the industry has seen in 40 years. We're changing how suppliers sell to the advisors who move $127B+ of travel a year, how those suppliers deliver personalized service, and how advisors get paid, faster and more reliably than ever. This is a $127B industry that should be a $300B one. We're making that happen, and it's going to run on Tern. Here's the problem. People think we're a better version of something they already use. We're not. We're an entirely new category, out to reimagine this industry for the better, and Tern is already transforming how advisors work today. We lose deals we should win, not because a competitor is better, but because the buyer doesn't grasp how different their business becomes on Tern. That gap shows up everywhere. It costs advisor and agency growth, and it shapes how suppliers and investors read the story. That's your job. Own Tern's brand and demand generation globally. Set Tern's 18 to 24 month marketing direction, bring structure to a fast-moving team, and make sure we ship every week. Make the transformation obvious, then turn that clarity into growth across advisors, agencies, and suppliers. You'll do it on a small team, in one-week cycles, with AI as your default leverage. We take the work seriously, not ourselves. If you need agencies or large teams be successful, this isn’t the role for you. It also isn't the seat if you need a fully defined plan before you can move, or if you default to tactics before setting direction. WHAT YOU'LL DO Own how Tern explains itself. Build the messaging that makes an advisor, a supplier, and an investor each get Tern in one sentence, backed by real proof like higher advisor earnings and less admin time. Find and tell the advisor stories that prove it. Tern's best marketing is a real advisor whose business changed. Go find those people and make sure everyone hears them. Build the advisor and agency demand engine across content, PR, digital, and events. A weekly motion, not quarterly campaigns. Run marketing and sales as one motion. Work hand in hand with Sales on ICP, pipeline definitions, and conversion. Turn product innovation into market growth. Partner with Product and Sales to shape how new product capabilities reach the market, strengthen Tern's differentiation, and drive adoption across advisors, agencies, and suppliers. Stand up Tern's brand in the hotel and supplier world as that side scales. Get Tern into the rooms, stages, and channels suppliers actually watch. Ship in one-week cycles. Small bets, measure fast, kill what doesn't work. Run marketing with AI as the default. The first question is always "can AI do this," not "who do we hire." Build and lead a small team supercharged with AI. We believe small, high-performing teams with AI as leverage are the future of marketing. Building that team is the job. If you're not the leader to build it, you're not the right fit. YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS Get your arms around everything marketing has in motion, decide what matters, put owners and metrics on it, and present a plan for where marketing takes Tern over the next two years. WHAT YOU HAVE Experience: 8+ years in marketing, including 3+ years leading a marketing function. Full-stack marketing leadership: You've led across paid media, product marketing, content, PR, and events, ideally in a producer-led industry. You've owned both brand and demand, not one lane. Builder instincts: You can zoom out to set direction and zoom in to sweat the details of what ships this week. Executive presence: You've operated on a leadership team and can lead with authority across sales, product, and the exec team, not just within marketing. Structure in ambiguity: You've walked into a fast, under-structured environment and turned it into a clear operating rhythm without slowing it down. AI-native execution: You run marketing with AI as core leverage. You can point to systems and campaigns you shipped that a much larger team would otherwise have needed. Narrative and category chops: You've taken a product that's hard to explain and made the market understand it. Better if you did it in a new or contested category. Team leadership with a small-team bias: You've led teams, and you're motivated by impact per head, not by headcount. BONUS POINTS Travel, hospitality, or supplier-side marketing experience You've marketed to a two-sided or producer-led ecosystem (advisors, agents, franchisees, sellers) A track record of building brand equity through events, awards, and speaking WHAT WE VALUE @ TERN 🌱 We're always leveling up. Whether you're deepening your craft, learning from a teammate, or embracing a new challenge, growth is core to our identity. 🧭 We act with optimistic agency. We take initiative, seek clarity, and move forward, even when the path isn't obvious. Through every peak and valley, we lead with curiosity, laughter, kindness, and resolve. 💪 We expect operational excellence. We ship value to our users every single week. We believe that compounding habits lead to sustainable productivity, consistency, and mutual trust. OPERATING PRINCIPLES: 👂 We deeply understand our users. At every level of the organization, we obsess about understanding those we serve and the industry we operate in. ➕ We embrace the power of and, and not now. We challenge trade-offs by asking better questions. We break hard problems into small pieces and tackle them with intention. We also know to make the hard call to say "not right now". 📣 We speak up and move forward. Everyone at Tern has a voice and a responsibility to use it. We invite healthy tension, share dissenting views early, and challenge each other with curiosity, not ego. 🏃 We move fast and sweat the details. Velocity matters and relentless progress beats perfection every time. But speed isn't chaos: we stay aligned, own our outcomes, and care deeply about quality. 🤣 We take the work seriously, but not ourselves. We hire kind, driven people who elevate the room. If you've got a big ego or take yourself too seriously, you won't last. WHY JOIN TERN? Be part of a mission-driven team transforming the travel planning space Work with a supportive, curious, and creative team Shape how the entire travel industry sees Tern Competitive salary, equity, and benefits package Tern is committed to building a team that represents people from many different backgrounds and life experiences, reflecting our worldview coinciding with the users and customers we serve across the world. We prefer that you apply, so think of our postings as the start of the conversation. Take the chance- you may be a wonderful add to our Tern team, even if you don't fully match every requirement on the job description.

new_jobs.description: Why Harvey At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. Role Overview We are hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join the Solutions Marketing team to build the foundation for how Harvey's products show up as real, usable solutions for legal professionals. You'll set the standard for how Harvey packages, launches, and enables solutions across legal teams and emerging markets. Working closely with Marketing, Product, and GTM teams to define clear workflows, practical use cases, and repeatable, customer-ready assets across different segments and buyers. Success shows up as shared clarity across GTM, faster customer adoption and value realization, quality pipeline, and a durable story that scales as Harvey grows. What You'll Do Lead go-to-market strategy for a core solution area, translating product capabilities into messaging and positioning tailored to the vertical, persona, and segment size. Enable GTM teams with solution-led messaging, demo storylines, playbooks, and customer-ready materials that support the enterprise sales motion. Partner with Product and Core Product Marketing to shape launches and own how it gets packaged and adapted across target verticals and personas. Partner with Demand Gen and Content to develop full funnel campaigns that build thought leadership, drive demand, and mature pipeline. Regularly conduct market, customer, and competitive research, grounding positioning and strategy in real customer needs and differentiated value. Align on solutions prioritization and market opportunity across Product, GTM, and Marketing leadership teams. What You Have 6-8+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Solutions Marketing, or a related role in B2B SaaS. Proven experience marketing complex, workflow-driven products to enterprise buyers. Demonstrated ability to connect technical product capabilities to customer problems, outcomes, and business value. Expertise in developing positioning and messaging, and translating it into sales-facing and customer-facing assets across different audiences, segments, and verticals. Experience contributing to product launches, including translating core launch messaging into content for specific industries or personas and building out assets. new_jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description: Remote, United States | Full time | Reports to the CEO Compensation: $120K to $150K total compensation (base plus performance bonus) plus equity. This is our founding marketing hire. You are being hired to fire the CEO from his second job. Whippy grew to 1,000+ customers with almost no marketing team. Pipeline comes from founder led webinars, partner channels, referrals, and customer stories good enough that prospects quote them back to us. Right now the CEO personally writes the case studies, directs the website, organizes the events, and approves every asset, while the audiences we already own sit untouched: no sequences, no retargeting, no cross sell motion. Your job covers both halves of that problem. You codify the message, and you build the machine that ships it. Then you own a pipeline number the way an AE owns a quota. One thing to know before you apply: this is a rare shape of role, deliberately. Most product marketers hand their messaging over a wall to someone else who distributes it. Most lifecycle marketers get handed messaging they didn't write. Here there is no wall. The person who writes the story builds the sequence it goes in. If you've spent your career on one side of that wall, this is not your job. If you've done both and hated the wall, keep reading. Why Whippy Whippy is the AI native platform for business communication: AI Voice Agents, AI Recruiting, messaging, VoIP, deep integrations, and our own workflow engine in one system. Our customers do not buy software that helps their employees do the work. They buy AI that does the work. Our deepest market is staffing and HR, where we are the category leader, and new verticals are already opening behind it. We are bootstrapped and profitable, with named, public case studies showing customers saving $1M+ per year. The proof exists. The machine to distribute it does not. That is the problem you are hired to fix. How we work Bootstrapped and profitable, so revenue is the strategy, and marketing is measured in pipeline, not impressions. No task is above or beneath anyone here: you will interview customers yourself, write the first draft yourself, and build the sequence yourself. Use AI for leverage: research, repurposing, ops, the grunt work. Never for voice. The mandate, in priority order Codify our messaging, then enforce it. Your first deliverable: extract our positioning from the founder's webinars, demos, and the language customers use in our case studies, and turn it into one messaging document. Positioning, product one liners, proof points, banned phrases, competitive framing against the tools we replace. The messaging exists today; it lives in the founder's head and a dozen slightly different pages. You make it one source of truth that everything you ship afterward draws from. Own email and lifecycle marketing end to end. This is where your messaging goes to work, immediately. Audiences we already own and never touch: a thousand customers who hold one product and have never heard about the other five, everyone who demoed and did not close, closed lost deals, and warm site traffic with no retargeting layer. You build the sequences, the drips, the new product announcement motion to the base and to dead pipeline, and the retargeting programs. Nothing here requires inventing demand. It requires finally talking to the people already in the building. Own marketing HubSpot. Today we run HubSpot as a CRM and nothing more: contacts are messy, marketing contacts are unmanaged, lifecycle stages are unused, and no lead has ever entered a nurture. You clean it up and make it the measurement backbone: contact hygiene and segmentation, marketing contact management, lifecycle stages, campaign tracking, and attribution from first visit through demo to close, working alongside our sales ops resource, so for the first time we can say which motion sourced which dollar. Build the proof engine. The CEO writes our case studies today, and prospects quote them back to us. You take that over: extract stories from webinar and call recordings, interview the customers, draft in our voice, get approvals, and arm every story as a page, a PDF, a one pager, and clips cut from recordings we already have. Then turn the library into enablement: battlecards against the tools we replace, per product one pagers built from our Solutions Engineer's technical documentation, and kits for the ATS partner reps who already recommend us inside their own demos and have never been given a single asset to do it with. Everything you write feeds everything you send. Turn events into campaigns, and manage our content writer. The CEO runs the webinars and the dinners; he is the talent. You make sure nothing he generates goes to waste: promotion and registration before, follow up sequences after, and extraction, so every webinar becomes case studies, clips, and campaigns within two weeks instead of sitting in a recording. And our blog and SEO writer reports to you: you set editorial priorities against the messaging doc, raise the bar, and turn one person patching articles into a content function. What success looks like First 30 days: the messaging doc exists and the CEO signed it, you know our six products, three main competitors, and customer stories cold, marketing contacts in HubSpot are cleaned and segmented, and the first lifecycle sequence is live. First 90 days: two new named case studies shipped and armed, cross sell and demo no close sequences producing measured pipeline, retargeting live, attribution reporting running in HubSpot from visit to close, and partner enablement kits in the hands of at least two ATS partner teams. Year one: marketing is a predictable pipeline channel with its own number, every customer and dead deal in our database is in a motion, the proof library covers every product and vertical, and the CEO has not written a case study, built a sequence, directed a website page, or chased an event follow up in six months. Who succeeds here You have 4+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, and your career crossed the wall: you did hands on lifecycle, email, or growth work, and you did real product marketing, positioning, competitive, enablement, whether or not the titles said so. Most people like this come from companies under 100 people, where they were one of one or two marketers and did everything because nobody else would. That's who we want. You can show us both kinds of receipts. Sequences you built with your own hands and what they produced. And named case studies or messaging work you personally shipped and got approved, with the story of how you got each customer to yes. You are genuinely strong in HubSpot: workflows, marketing contacts, segmentation, lifecycle stages, attribution, not just sending emails from it. You write clearly and fast enough that a demanding founder reads your draft and does not reach for the red pen. You know your numbers: pipeline sourced, conversion rates, what each motion returns. Ideally you've done this at a vertical SaaS company selling to SMB owners and operators. Bonus points if you started in sales or SDR work, because you will be embedded with the sales team and you need their instincts. This is not for you if You want a brand or pure strategy role. This is a shipping role with a strategy layer, in that order. You can position or you can distribute, but not both. Half this job is writing the message, half is building the machine that sends it. Missing either half makes this a bad time. You have opinions about email marketing but have never built the workflow yourself. You talk strategy more fluently than you talk numbers. You need an agency and a big budget before anything ships. You want to manage the work instead of doing the work. Why join now The hardest part of marketing is having something true to say. We have customers saving seven figures with named executives on the record, a category lead in AI, partner reps who recommend us unprompted, a founder who generates demand every time he speaks, and thousands of people already in our database who have never been sent any of it. You are the first marketing hire on a clean cap table. The message is yours to codify and the machine is yours to build, and you get to do it your way.

new_jobs.title: SEM Senior Manager
new_jobs.location: NZ: Auckland: Xero 4 (96 St Georges Bay Rd, Level 2 & 3)
new_jobs.description: The role / impact As the SEM Senior Manager, you will play a critical role in shaping the future of Xero’s global Paid Search program. This is a highly technical, hands-on role focused on using automation, AI and data to unlock scalable growth and improve how our SEM operation works. You will help evolve the technical foundations of the channel, from AI-powered optimisation workflows and automation through to feeds, scripting and new ways of using emerging technology across search. You’ll work closely with SEM specialists, Data Science, Marketing Technology and Product teams to turn complex performance challenges into scalable solutions. Your impact will go beyond campaign optimisation. You’ll help define how Xero applies AI and automation to Paid Search, build systems that improve decision quality and speed, and act as a senior technical voice across the organisation, translating complex ideas into clear opportunities for senior stakeholders. The team / how they connect You will join Xero’s global SEM team, a specialist group spanning technical SEM, bidding and optimisation, creative and AI. The team manages Paid Search across Xero’s global markets and is focused on using data, experimentation and technology to continually improve performance and unlock new growth opportunities. You’ll work closely with the Head of SEM and our existing SEM team, while partnering across Data Science, Marketing Technology, Product, CRO and the wider Performance Marketing organisation. As a senior leader within the team, you’ll bring new ideas, share your expertise and help elevate the technical capability of those around you. Initially, you will focus on: Evolving the technical foundations of our global SEM program, identifying opportunities to improve scalability, automation and performance Building and operationalising AI-powered workflows that automate optimisation, analysis, reporting and operational processes Advancing our AI-driven SEM capabilities, including automated bidding and decision-making systems, with robust validation, guardrails and measurement Identifying and delivering new automation opportunities, turning manual or complex SEM processes into scalable, reusable solutions Partnering with Data Science, Marketing Technology and Product to connect data, AI and emerging technology into our SEM ecosystem Exploring emerging search and AI capabilities, testing where new technologies can create genuine commercial advantage Where and how you can work Xero offers a hybrid working model that balances flexibility with the value of working together in person. You’ll spend time in our office collaborating with the team, while also having the flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. As part of a global SEM and Performance Marketing team, you’ll also collaborate regularly with colleagues and partners across different markets and time zones. Here are some of the things we are looking for Deep, hands-on SEM expertise, with experience managing large-scale, multi-market Paid Search programs and a strong understanding of Google Ads, SA360 and modern bidding and automation Proven technical builder capability, with experience designing and deploying automation, workflows or other technical solutions that solve real performance marketing problems Hands-on experience with AI and workflow orchestration tools, such as Tray.ai , AirOps, n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI, Claude or similar technologies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through complex performance and technical challenges and turn data into clear actions A proactive, solutions-first mindset, someone who naturally identifies opportunities, experiments and builds rather than waiting for a brief Strong communication and stakeholder skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations and influence senior stakeholders A collaborative, low-ego approach, with a willingness to share knowledge, mentor others and elevate the technical capability of the wider team If you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you. We’re looking for deep SEM and technical capability, but we know great candidates can develop those skills through different experiences and career paths. At Xero, we value your skills, curiosity, passion and the unique perspective you can bring to our team.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Automation Specialist
new_jobs.description: The role As the Marketing Automation Specialist, you will join Xero's Customer Engagement team to design, build, test, schedule, deploy, and report on global and regional communications using a modern marketing tech stack. You will be hands-on in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), ensuring campaigns reliably reach small business users worldwide to help make running their businesses seamless. A key part of this position involves driving operational efficiency across the team. You will play a vital role in lifting delivery maturity by refining reusable email templates, documenting clear processes, sharing technical insights, and partnering with regional marketers on their quarterly communication plans. The team & how they connect You will join a high-performing Global Customer Engagement team that works in close partnership with Regional Marketing, Product Marketing, and Data & Insights specialists. The team operates with a focus on peer collaboration, shared learning, and thorough QA to streamline workflows across all regions. Together, they combine technical execution with commercial insights to build meaningful, tailored experiences for our audience. Initially, you will focus on Hands-on campaign creation and deployment using Salesforce Marketing Cloud and in-product messaging tools. Building dynamic, personalized content using HTML, AMPscript, and SQL. Managing end-to-end campaign QA, audience segmentation logic, and data troubleshooting. Standardizing build patterns, updating team documentation, and delivering operational sends. Where and how you can work Xero offers a flexible hybrid work environment designed to support balance, focus, and collaboration. You will have access to modern office spaces for team connection and dedicated boost days. Here are some of the things we are looking for Experience managing multi-region or multi-segment email and CRM campaigns. Technical capability using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SQL for dynamic content creation. Solid understanding of data ingestion, file imports, and audience segmentation rules. Demonstrated ability to run end-to-end campaign QA, resolve automation issues, and evaluate delivery metrics. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills to manage competing deadlines and translate technical requirements clearly. A proactive approach to documenting processes, sharing knowledge, and simplifying daily workflows. Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

new_jobs.title: Vertical Marketing Lead, Gaming
new_jobs.description: Why Socure? Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.
